summary.text: Will Campbell is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 109 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Aicha Davis.
In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey, he said his priorities include ending property taxes, replacing them with a flat sales tax, and making it easier to start businesses.

paragraphs.text: Campbell advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
In his Ballotpedia survey, he said he was asked to run as a Republican for District 109 to be part of a larger team seeking change in how state government operates.
He called for lean government, lower taxes and a business-friendly environment, and said the state could end property taxes and replace them with an impartial flat sales tax on all transactions.
He also listed improving infrastructure and encouraging innovation in the laws governing logistics and energy distribution among his policy interests.
